name: Collective Adept (Psionic)
body:
Your psionic nature allows you to harness the power of your collective more efficiently.

Prerequisite: Collective class feature or telepath discipline, elan.

Benefit: You gain a +2 bonus to all concentration checks made to manifest or maintain powers and abilities with the network descriptor.

Book of Heroic Races: Advanced Elans. © 2015, Jon Brazer Enterprises
